page0.text:
I'll try asking Fuji-nee for help.
She's older, and she might have an easier time convincing Sakura.

page1.text:
"Fuji-nee, about Sakura staying over, could you ask her for me?"
"Why? I don't wanna get kicked by a horse.
You should be the one to break it to her, Shirou."

page2.text:
"Stu—of course I want to, but she'll say no if it's me.
We might know each other pretty well, but I'm a guy. Sakura will be uncomfortable if I ask her to stay over.
...If the stakes were lower then it'd be easier, but I can't afford to have her say no this time."

page3.text:
"...Haah. I forget how thick you are sometimes.
Fine. I just need to let her know, right? Does a week sound about right?"
"Yeah. I think everyone will feel better about that."

page4.text:
Just then,
the doorbell rings with perfect timing.

page5.text:
"I'm coming in!"
Sakura's voice comes from the front door.
"I'll tell her now. You focus on making dinner."
Fuji-nee unenthusiastically gets up to greet Sakura.
...Hm.
Did I ask the wrong person...?

page6.text:
"Sakura says okay. I just showed her to the guest room, so she'll be here soon."
With that nonchalant report, Fuji-nee takes her seat back at the table.

page7.text:
"Huh? She said yes, just like that?"
"Of course she did, you dummy."
Fuji-nee replies in a bored tone, while peeling a mandarin.

page8.text:
...
Hm.
I don't know how that conversation went, but I was right to ask Fuji-nee.
